title: Derive Revenue Column
description:
Acme’s overnight sales Parquet is already cleaned — every row is a completed line Finance trusts. What BI still lacks is a single line revenue figure they can sum without re-deriving discounts in every dashboard.

Your job is to add a `revenue` column to each row and write the enriched Parquet with overwrite. Keep every input column unchanged; only append `revenue`.

Formula: `revenue = quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct)`, rounded to 2 decimal places as `DECIMAL(12,2)`. `discount_pct` is a fraction in `[0, 0.50]` (for example `0.10` means 10% off), not a whole-number percent.

Input columns: `transaction_id`, `store_id`, `product_id`, `customer_id`, `quantity`, `unit_price`, `discount_pct`, `currency`, `status`, `transaction_timestamp`. Implement with Spark DataFrame APIs (`withColumn`, arithmetic, cast) — no Python loops over collected rows. **Run** uses two smoke testcases; **Submit** uses the full set and row-diffs your Parquet against each case’s `expected/`.

problemStatement.overview: Add a DECIMAL(12,2) revenue column: quantity × unit_price × (1 − discount_pct), keep all input columns, write Parquet to OUTPUT_PATH.
symptoms: BI dashboards re-derive discounts differently and disagree on overnight totals.
Finance wants a single line revenue field on every sales row.
yourTaskSteps: Read input Parquet from INPUT_PATH (platform stages selected testcase inputs).
Add revenue = quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct) as DECIMAL(12,2).
Preserve all input columns; append revenue; write Parquet to OUTPUT_PATH with overwrite.
Submit is graded with a row-level compare against each selected testcase expected/.
problemStatement.yourTask: Implement src/main.py that derives revenue and writes Parquet output.
hints: Use withColumn to append revenue without dropping other columns.
Cast intermediates to decimal before multiplying if you need stable scale.
discount_pct is a fraction (0.10 = 10%), already between 0 and 0.50.
spark.read.parquet(INPUT_PATH) reads every staged testcase file.

expectedOutput.description: DECIMAL(12,2) = quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct), half-up to 2 dp

gradeChecks: Spark job succeeds on selected Submit testcases
OUTPUT_PATH Parquet readable with input columns plus revenue
Each Submit testcase expected/ matches candidate rows (key + values)
No extra rows beyond the union of selected expected testcases
